name: browser-vision
purpose: Headless browser capture and coordinate-grid actions for agent use.

tools.name: view
tools.one_liner: Load a URL and return a screenshot with coordinate-grid metadata.

tools.name: click
tools.one_liner: Click a grid cell after a mandatory pre-click screenshot.

tools.name: type
tools.one_liner: Type text into a focused grid cell on a fine-grained grid.

tools.name: scroll
tools.one_liner: Scroll from a grid cell in a direction on a coarse or medium grid.
